description: This file implements the OrleansRelationalDownloadStream class, a chunked stream reader for ADO.NET database providers that lack native support for streaming data via DbDataReader.GetStream(int). It provides functionality for reading database columns as streams, including asynchronous read and copy operations, with implementation details focused on efficient data transfer and resource management.

classes.name: OrleansRelationalDownloadStream
classes.description: A custom stream implementation for chunked reading of database columns, designed for providers that do not support native streaming.

methods.name: Read
methods.description: Reads data from the database reader into a buffer synchronously.

methods.name: ReadAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously reads data from the database reader into a buffer with cancellation support.

methods.name: CopyToAsync
methods.description: Copies data asynchronously from this stream to a destination stream with a specified buffer size and cancellation support.
